acceptanceCriteria.text: A versioned JSON schema and TypeScript/JSDoc-compatible data contract are defined under the isolated review-pages/review boundary rather than core runtime.
Verdict is restricted to APPROVE / CHANGES_REQUIRED / INCONCLUSIVE.
Findings support severity, blocking, evidence references, optional source location and lifecycle status.
Inspected inputs, omitted inputs and unknowns are representable and distinguishable.
Stale-head misuse is prevented by explicit head-SHA identity.
Schema validation tests cover valid results and malformed/ambiguous/stale-identity fixtures.
No LLM provider implementation is introduced in this issue.

issue.title: feat: define structured autonomous review result contract
